summary: Re-ran /app/backend_test.py end-to-end against https://mint-app.preview.emergentagent.com after main agent's two server.py fixes. Dropped db.app_links singleton (mongosh) and restarted backend to exercise the fresh-DB seed path. RESULT: 35/35 PASS (100%). Both previously-failing flows are now green: (a) GET /api/links includes telegram_contact and business_contact on fresh seed; (b) POST /api/tasks/watch returns reward in [20,50], remaining starts at 19, 20 successful calls, 21st returns 400 'Daily watch limit reached'. All other flows (admin delete-user + cascade, reject/approve withdrawal with refund + admin_note, campaign approve/reject/delete + re-submit, smoke checks) remain green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1722 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, tasks, admin, wallet, withdraw, seed) for maintainability. Not blocking.

Seed logic for app_links still has two paths (migration update_one + insert_one). Now consistent because insert_one was patched to include all fields, but consolidating into one upsert with $setOnInsert would prevent future drift.
seed_data_creation: Dropped db.app_links and restarted backend before run to trigger seed_initial_data fresh-insert path. Each test still creates throwaway device users (deluser_/wd_/watch_/camp_a_/camp_b_). Admin promoted per-run via /api/auth/admin-login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green at 35/35. Both fixes verified: (1) seed_initial_data now seeds telegram_contact and business_contact on fresh DB (server.py ~line 1665-1675), and (2) /api/tasks/watch rewards randint(20,50) with 20/day cap and remaining=19-today_count (server.py ~line 835-848). To re-exercise the fresh-seed assertion in future, drop the app_links singleton: mongosh --eval 'use("test_database"); db.app_links.drop();' then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. rca_of_issue: Both previously-reported issues confirmed FIXED. Issue 1 (business_contact missing): main agent added 'telegram_contact': '' and 'business_contact': '' to the insert_one dict inside seed_initial_data. Verified by dropping app_links and re-hitting GET /api/links — both keys present. Issue 2 (watch reward/limit drift): main agent changed random.randint(50,100) -> random.randint(20,50) and the cap check from >=5 to >=20 with `remaining = 19 - today_count`. Verified by 21 sequential POST /api/tasks/watch calls: 20 returned reward in [20,50] with decreasing remaining 19→0, 21st returned 400 with 'Daily watch limit reached'.
